summary: Backend-only testing of the weighted_similarity_v2 refactor via the public URL. Created pytest suite (37 tests) at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covering meta, all 3 new admin endpoints (material/pressure/similarity) incl. validation, estimation math (material factor, pressure factor on bara, size scaling, weighted mean, Neff, quantity), scaling-variable selection & fallback, reference exclusions, row CRUD + field sanitization, explicit AACE class, project totals, and FRED indices. All 37 tests pass (source='FRED' live). Math verified numerically: F_pressure=((25+1.01325)/(8+1.01325))^0.6 matched applied_pressure_factor within 1%; F_material=2.1/1.0 exact; sum(normalized_weight)=1.0; expected==sum(weighted_contribution); Neff=1/sum(w^2) ~1.99 for 2 refs. HOWEVER 3 behavioral gaps found that deviate from the requested spec (fallback path and missing-pressure path both yield estimate_available=false, and the excluded-refs JSON key name differs between success and failure responses).

critical.issue: Fallback scaling variable is effectively unusable. Column with only size=50 (no weight_kg) selects fallback (warning 'Fallback variable used for target: weight_kg unavailable, using m³') but ALL references are then excluded with reason 'incompatible scaling variable (target=size/fallback, ref=weight_kg)' because the homogeneity check requires ref_sv.is_fallback == target_sv.is_fallback. Result: estimate_available=false, expected/low/high=null (row -> unit_expected_cost 0.0, scaling_variable=None). Spec expected scaling_variable='size', scaling_variable_is_fallback=true with a usable estimate. Fix by comparing only the variable NAME (allow a ref that has weight_kg to also be evaluated on size when the target is in fallback mode), or seed references without weight_kg.

design_pressure_bar is de-facto mandatory for column/reactor/vessel/storage_tank/heat_exchanger/valve although it is Optional in EstimatePreview/EquipmentRowCreate and NOT in CATEGORY_META['column']['required_fields'] (=size, material). Omitting it excludes every reference with 'pressure required but missing' -> estimate_available=false. A UI form that respects required_fields will silently produce a zero-cost row. Either add design_pressure_barg to required_fields for pressure-enabled categories (and validate with 400/422), or skip the pressure factor (F=1) when the target pressure is absent.

minor.issue: Inconsistent response schema between success and failure. Success returns 'references_excluded'; the all-excluded / no-references branches return 'excluded_references' (or omit it entirely) and also omit scaling_variable, scaling_variable_is_fallback, sigma, effective_sample_size, total_expected/low/high, similarity/material/pressure summaries. Frontend reading a single key will break.

When estimate_available=false the row still stores unit_expected_cost/unit_low/unit_high/total_expected_cost = 0.0 and escalation_factor=0.0 (spec asked for non-zero/null semantics). Project totals therefore silently include 0-cost rows; consider Optional[float]=None on EquipmentRow result fields or an explicit flag surfaced in totals.

No historical references seeded for the new 'vessel' category (or 'other'), so every vessel estimate returns estimate_available=false with 'no historical references found for this category'. Add seed references for vessel.

Invalid numeric inputs are silently downgraded instead of rejected: weight_kg=-5 for a column is treated as 'weight unavailable' and falls back to size (then all refs excluded). Negative/zero size, weight_kg, power_kw should be rejected with 422/400 via Pydantic (gt=0).

action_items: Decide & fix fallback-variable semantics so a column/reactor/etc. without weight_kg can still be estimated on size (currently returns no estimate)
Make target design pressure either truly required (400/422) or optional-with-F=1 for pressure-enabled categories
Unify excluded-references key name to 'references_excluded' and return the full key set in failure branches of estimate_full
Seed historical references for the new 'vessel' category
Add Pydantic gt=0 validation for size/weight_kg/power_kw/quantity
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1492 lines - split into modules (models, estimation engine, routes/admin, seed).
_sanitize_row_payload contains a dead no-op loop (for f in (...): pass) at ~line 1170 - remove.
estimate_full has 6 different early-return dict shapes; extract a single _unavailable(...) helper to guarantee a stable response contract.

Weighted sigma is the biased weighted variance and low is clipped at 0; with only 2 references the +/-1.645*sigma bracket can collapse to [0, 2*expected]. Consider a small-sample correction using n_eff.
min_references (an integer count) is compared against n_eff (a float effective sample size) at line 906 - semantically mixed.
FX-fallback warning is appended once per reference, producing duplicated warnings; de-duplicate the warnings list before returning.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in current FastAPI - migrate to the lifespan context manager.
get_similarity_config merges the stored doc including 'updated_at' into the config returned by GET /admin/similarity-settings; harmless today but leaks a persistence field into the config contract.

success_rate.backend: 100% of 37 executed assertions/tests pass; 2 HIGH spec deviations found via exploratory probing

seed_data_creation: Temp project 'TEST_it2_project' (Class 3) + rows and 'TEST_aace' project created and deleted by fixtures. Admin config (duplex material factor, vessel pressure exponent, similarity beta/min_similarity) mutated and verified restored to defaults: min_similarity=0.1, duplex=3.0, vessel exponent=0.55. Only the DUMMY project remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q (pytest.ini uses xdist -n 2 --dist loadscope). IMPORTANT: all tests that mutate the GLOBAL similarity config must live inside the TestSimilaritySettings class, otherwise a parallel worker resets the config mid-test (this caused a false failure initially). Tests intentionally accept both outcomes for the column-fallback and vessel cases - tighten those assertions once the main agent fixes the fallback/pressure gaps. Seeded refs: 13 historical records, no 'vessel' rows; column refs are 32000kg carbon_steel@8barg and 38000kg SS316@8barg.
rca_of_the_issue: Fallback gap RCA: estimate_full (~line 675) excludes any reference whose scaling-variable fallback flag differs from the target's (ref_sv['is_fallback'] != target_sv['is_fallback']). Since every seeded column reference has weight_kg, its selector returns the primary variable (is_fallback=False) while a weight-less target is in fallback mode, so 100% of references are excluded and the estimate is unavailable. Missing-pressure RCA: at ~line 727, when a category has pressure enabled and exponent>0, a None target absolute pressure triggers the 'exclude' policy for every reference, so an otherwise valid payload (pressure not listed in required_fields) yields no estimate.
